newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran mine blast kills 18, injures 29 - television.
newsitem.headline: Iran mine blast kills 18, injures 29 - television.

text.p: An explosion at a coal mine in northern Iran has killed at least 18 miners and injured 29, Iranian state-run television said on Monday.
Nine of those injured were in critical condition, said the television, monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation.
Sunday's accident occurred at the Sangrud colliery in Gilan province when methane gas leaked into the mine and was ignited by an electrical fault, the television added.
The daily Ettelaat said on Monday the casualties from the blast were taken to hospital and a team of experts was sent to the mining tunnel to investigate the incident.
The official news agency IRNA reported earlier on Monday some 150 people had been trapped underground.
It was not immediately clear if those trapped men were rescued.
